name: Exrbition
summary:
Exrbition turns the room you’re in into an art gallery.

Hang a collection of framed artworks on your real walls, then wander through them at your own pace. Each piece has a frosted-glass label beside it. Step up close, take it in, and open any work to see it at full size.

FEATURES
• Mixed reality gallery: frames hang on your actual walls and sit naturally in your space.
